floor_area_ratio.reason: 同上：法定容积率条件缺失且不在智能体成果边界内。 Same as above: the statutory FAR condition is missing and lies outside the Agent deliverable boundary.

official_building_density.reason: 控规建筑密度条件缺失，本方案只提供概念基底占比。 The regulatory building-density condition is missing; this package only reports a conceptual footprint share.

building_height_m.reason: 缺少经批准的高度控制、航空/景观/文保约束条件。 Approved height controls and aviation, landscape and heritage constraints are unavailable.

setback_m.reason: 缺少道路红线、建筑控制线、消防与市政条件。 Road redlines, building control lines, fire and municipal conditions are unavailable.
